target_buyer_1.organization: Visit Ashtabula (Ashtabula County Convention & Visitors Bureau)
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Official tourism bureau for Ashtabula County promoting Ohio Wine Country. 26 miles of Lake Erie shoreline, Grand River Valley with 30+ wineries growing 50%+ of Ohio's grapes. Features 19 covered bridges, 4 scenic rivers, 2 state parks. Offers trip planner tool at visitashtabulacounty.visitwidget.com. Already has itinerary-building infrastructure - MyTrip Export would integrate perfectly with their existing trip planning system.

target_buyer_2.organization: Ashtabula County Convention & Visitors Bureau (Official County Entity)
target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Official county travel and tourism office providing marketing and tourism information. Operates physical visitors center with maps and brochures. Partners with Visit Ashtabula website. County government backing provides legitimacy and potential for broader regional adoption. Social media presence on Twitter (@VacationInAshCo) and Facebook.
